role: benchmark conditioning evidence; one timecourse per configuration, no source/native ratio or parity claim
machine: onnx-bench Standard_D4as_v7, AMD EPYC9V45, CPU2, one logical CPU per process
collection: 12prospectively fixed90second jobs, untraced then traced; FP32medium andINT8short, selected baseline and experimental route off/on; every call and every10second bin retained
qualification: Both cores previously passed original/controlled/waveform-only private facts on .NET10 and .NET11. Both experimental modes passed12facts per framework and48paired actual-route conditions before collection.
boundaries: Reset, complete Execute and owned float output copy are timed. Timecourse validation/hashing outside those clocks differs from GraphBench; these values are not coordinator scores.
sample_profile: dotnet-sampled-thread-time; stack samples include threads regardless of CPU usage. CLR GC/JIT/loader/compilation events are separate, with zero reported event loss.
decision: Use at least32calls AND40seconds conditioning on both engines in every fresh Paradee cohort. Keep33measured calls, six balanced process pairs, original models, copy boundaries, numerical limits and1.03point/upper95target. Do not combine historical10second scores with40second cohorts.
